title: Chapter 221: Becoming Famous And Joining The War
content:
Chapter 221: Becoming Famous And Joining The War

The effect of the Heavenly Silkworm Knight promoting the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations in the Fold Ear Cat City was particularly good. In the Free Land, everyone's emphasis on strength exceeded Wu Qing's imagination.

The strong prey on the weak. In many cases, the difference in strength is too great. People in the Free Land can do anything to improve their strength.

Now there is such a good opportunity in front of them, and few people will worry too much.

Especially seeing familiar people pass the inheritance of the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations, the strength instantly widened the gap with them, this kind of stimulation is very strong.

A large number of people in the Fold Ear City got the news and came to the Heavenly Silkworm Knight for testing in order to obtain the inheritance of the skills. The Heavenly Silkworm Knight with only 100 people was simply too busy.

After obtaining the consent of the Fold Ear Cat Clan, Wu Qing sent a transport host to transport a large number of two-star Heavenly Silkworm Knights to the Fold Ear City.

When several huge Zerg transport hosts flew directly to the Fold Ear City, it once again caused a sensation in the Fold Ear City.

The arrival of Zerg transport hosts and a large number of two-star Silkworm Knights gave everyone a more intuitive understanding of the strength of the Zerg, especially the transport hosts, which were not something that ordinary races could bring out.

The reputation of the Zerg was completely established in Zheer City and began to spread to the surrounding areas.

The people in the Free Land determined that people's hearts were complicated, and a large number of people with impure minds participated in the test and were eliminated.

The more people she came into contact with, the stronger the Queen's ability to identify people became. Most people only needed to be seen by the Silkworm Knights, and the Queen would have a basic judgment. Then she would ask a targeted question to judge whether a person met Wu Qing's character requirements.

Wu Qing could now understand the mentality of the senior masters in those martial arts novels who accepted disciples. It was very uncomfortable to learn from others and pass on what they had learned.

He did not want the Nine Changes of the Silkworm to be passed on to the evil people. Even if the Zerg could eventually control and destroy them, Wu Qing did not like this feeling.

All things are difficult at the beginning. If you make a good start, things will be much easier in the future.

With the power of example and the influence of the Zerg's display of strength, in a very short period of time, the number of inheritors of the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations in Fold Ear City exceeded 100,000, and many Fold Ear Cats also accepted the inheritance.

The Fold Ear Cats are a microcosm of the countless small races in this world. If a strong race or force disregards the order of the camp and wants to attack them, their self-protection ability is very weak.

So for a race like the Zerg, even if the promoted technique is a parasitic practice method, they do not restrict the tribe members from practicing.

Just like Wu Qing looked down on the Fold Ear Cats, the real big and strong tribes would not bother to use conspiracy and tricks against small races like them.

In addition, there is no strong inheritance in their tribe, and they will not stop the tribe members from pursuing strong strength.

Moreover, they have tried that switching to the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations does not affect the use of various combat skills inherited in their tribe.

The Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations is not only powerful, but also very compatible.

The Silkworm Knights made a great success in Folding Ear City, leaving some people to continue promoting it in Folding Ear City. Other Silkworm Knights continued to go to other cities with the support of some intelligence provided by the Folding Ear Cats.

Wu Qing learned from the Folding Ear Cats that the war between the Southern Free Land and the Evil God Camp has now entered a stable period. The fighting is not very frequent, and there are more local wars.

The Folding Ear Cats have an elite force stationed on the front line, responsible for the defense of a section of the front line.

Although there is no unified management of the Southern Free Land by a large clan, many of the powerful clans and major forces in it have also made some agreements to organize forces to fight against the Evil God Camp under the order of the local camp.

The territory of the Southern Free Land is very large, enough to be compared with the territories of more than a dozen large clans, and the overall strength is very strong.

Wu Qing told the Folding Ear Cats through the Silkworm Knights that the Zerg wanted to go to the front battlefield to see if the Folding Ear Cats needed it, the Zerg could send troops to assist them in the battle.

This made the Scottish Fold Cats, a small tribe that had no say in the Southern Free Land, feel a little flattered, and they said they would welcome the Zerg to visit the front line at any time.

Regardless of whether the Zerg is a large tribe, the Scottish Fold Cats can see the strength of the Zerg from the Nine Transformations of the Silkworm and the transport-type host. As long as a race stronger than them is willing to help at this critical period, they are certainly willing.

…

The Zerg has opened up a little situation in the Southern Free Land.

On the other hand, Host No. 3 and more than 10,000 Zerg destroyers who followed Naga to the Naga tribe finally waited for Naga, who had been busy all the time.

As Naga said, she would go to the tribe after she returned to the tribe and settled the troops and personnel she brought back.

Host No. 3 led the army to teleport through the Naga tribe's space transmission channel, and he didn't know where he was. Without reference objects and reliable world maps, his understanding of geography would be very vague.

Not only Wu Qing was like this, he estimated that most people in this world were like this.

In such a big world, you can't walk far directly. You can't figure out the direction at all by passing through space transmission channels, one after another.

Wu Qing asked Naga and Gong Zhe. They have a certain concept of geographical knowledge, but they know nothing about many things.

Just like when Wu Qing asked Naga妶where the Naga tribe's territory was and whether it was far from the Zerg territory, Naga妶only knew that it was in the far north, but she couldn't tell how far it was and what places were in between.

Gong Zhe of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce knew that there was a branch of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce near the Southern Free Land. They often walked in unfamiliar places, and the recorded information was only responsible for uploading to the tribe for unified management.

They didn't need to go back, so they didn't need to draw maps to remember place names, and their own records were not meaningful. They followed the tribe's orders and passed through a space transmission channel on the way, and all the previous records were invalidated.

In this case, perhaps only a large tribe like the Goblin Tribe would have a relatively complete map. This information was absolutely confidential and would definitely not be provided to the outside.

Wu Qing stopped thinking about the map for the time being and slowly drew his own map. With the convenience of the Zerg and the Queen, as long as the Zerg units had been to a place, they could record it and draw it on a giant map.

When the recorded information was sufficient, the azimuth coordinates were adjusted uniformly to get the correct map.

Naga came to host No. 3 in person to talk about the expedition. She personally told host No. 3 some things to pay attention to.

Then, host No. 3 and the Zerg army finally came out of a Naga camp. They followed Naga and were teleported to the battlefield area of the camp war in charge of the Naga tribe through a giant space transmission channel.

Wu Qing saw through host No. 3 in the Naga tribe. This is a city with strong ethnic characteristics. Its size is so large that even if host No. 3 flies in the air, he can't see the whole picture.

In a city with strict defense, continuing to fly upward will be attacked, so host No. 3 can only give up.

All the people seen along the way are Naga people. The weakest of these Naga people are Naga warriors, which means that most of the people in this city have a strength of one star or above.

There are also many people with higher stars, and occasionally you can see powerful Naga people.

This shows how strong the Naga tribe is.

Just pick up some people on the street and you can form a powerful elite force. This is worthy of being the tribe of the fighting race.

The five thousand Zerg destroyers in the Zerg army who have not entered the star level may be the weakest troops in this city.

After being teleported to the battlefield through the teleportation array, all they saw were the elite troops of the Naga tribe. No troops of any other races were seen, which shows how much Naga attaches importance to the Zerg army.

"Elite soldiers against elite soldiers, this battlefield is the battlefield of star-level troops, and those ordinary troops are on another battlefield."

Naga explained to the host No. 3 who was following her.

Naga felt that the host No. 3 was a Zerg wise man with a style similar to Wu Qing, who knew a lot and was very capable, so she brought him with her.

This also made it convenient to command the Zerg destroyers through the host No. 3.

"No. 3, when you are on the battlefield, just attack forward. If the attack is effective, I will hire more troops from your lord later!"

"Look at the long-range siege equipment made by the goblins. It is very expensive to use it once. They often have to be saved for critical moments, and many tribesmen are lost in vain!"

"I would rather pay more and hire siege troops from you!"

Naga chatted with host No. 3 while walking.

From her words, it can be heard that the long-range attack ability of the Naga tribe is relatively weak.

It took a lot of time to walk out of the front-line city of the Naga tribe. Outside the city is an endless plain with countless barracks densely located on the plain.

Naga took host No. 3 and tens of thousands of Zerg destroyers and continued to move forward.

The Naga tribe should be creatures of earth attribute. They like to walk on the ground very much. They don't need mounts or tools.

Wu Qing guessed that they should be able to speed up their recovery by touching the ground, which is somewhat similar to the Zerg's speeding up recovery by drilling into the ground.

The Naga tribe was not slow, and soon arrived at the battle area of the battlefield. There were already Naga warriors waiting in full formation.

The weakest in this army were the one-star Naga warriors, and the officers at all levels were even stronger, with a force of about 100,000.

With only 100,000 troops, millions of ordinary troops might not be able to defeat them in a real fight.

Host No. 3 followed Naga's arrangement and commanded the Zerg Destroyers to join this army. The Naga warriors with 100,000 troops adjusted the formation and placed the Zerg Destroyers in the core position for protection.

Also in the core position with the Zerg Destroyers were those goblin creations. Although there were not many of them, each one looked very extraordinary.

Under the command of Naga, the Naga army maintained its formation and began to advance.

Wu Qing had already seen the enemies of the Naga tribe through Host No. 3, who had a high advantage.
